description.en: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce.
description.ro: Ouă pocate într-un sos condimentat de roșii și ardei.
description.ar: بيض مطهو في صلصة طماطم وفلفل متبلة.

ingredients: Fresh parsley or coriander to serve
steps: Heat the oil in a wide pan and cook the onion and pepper for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, paprika and cumin and stir for 1 minute.
Pour in the tomatoes, season, and simmer for 8 minutes until thick.
Make four hollows in the sauce and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook for 5 to 6 minutes until the whites are set. Scatter the herbs and serve with bread.
